title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Matthew 26: the plot against Jesus, the ointment at Bethany, the Passover meal, Gethsemane, and Peter's denials.

questions.text: What did Jesus say was coming after two days?
questions.explanation: He told his disciples that after two days the Passover was coming, and that the Son of Man would be delivered up to be crucified.

questions.text: In whose court did the chief priests, scribes, and elders gather?
questions.explanation: They gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas, and took counsel to take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

questions.text: What did the woman in the house of Simon the leper pour on his head?
questions.explanation: A woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment and poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

questions.text: What did Jesus say the woman had done in pouring the ointment on him?
questions.explanation: He said that in pouring the ointment on his body she did it to prepare him for burial.

answers.text: Given what should have gone to the poor

questions.text: What did the chief priests weigh out for Judas Iscariot?
questions.explanation: When Judas asked what they were willing to give him to deliver Jesus, they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

questions.text: How did Jesus describe the one who would betray him, as they were eating?
questions.explanation: He answered that the one who dipped his hand with him in the dish would betray him.

answers.text: As the one who dipped his hand with him in the dish
As the one who would sleep in the garden
As the one who carried the money
As the one sitting at his right hand

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the cup he gave them?
questions.explanation: He said that this is his blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

answers.text: That it was the cup of the Passover lamb
That they should keep it until he returned
That it should be poured out on the altar
That it is his blood of the new covenant

questions.text: What did they do before they went out to the Mount of Olives?
questions.explanation: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

questions.text: What did Jesus pray when he went forward a little and fell on his face?
questions.explanation: He prayed that, if it were possible, this cup might pass away from him; nevertheless, not what he desired, but what his Father desired.

answers.text: That the cup might pass away from him
That the disciples would not be scattered
That the hour would come quickly
That his betrayer would be kept away

questions.text: What happened immediately after Peter denied for the third time that he knew Jesus?
questions.explanation: After he began to curse and swear that he did not know the man, the rooster crowed; Peter remembered what Jesus had said, went out, and wept bitterly.

answers.text: The high priest tore his clothing
The disciples came back for him
